fields: He is strong right now thanks to sustained burn damage from his items, so expect him to hit harder than he looks.
A truly even matchup. Play your normal game and focus on denying her objectives.
Weaker than before but still a strong farmer. Build an early lead through ganks and mirror his pathing so he cannot take objectives.
Easy, similar to fighting Master Yi. Dodge her E, which hits hard, and knock her up during her Q leap to cancel it.
Still dangerous, but you are fine unless she lands her full combo. Use your ultimate to dodge hers or wait for her spells to be used before engaging.
His W bubble can negate your damage and let him burst you. His ultimate dodges yours, so do not use it early.
Skill-based. Dodge her human E at all costs or you get one-shot, and remember her spider E lets her avoid your knock-up and ultimate.
Your Tremor Sense gives you vision of her, but she still bursts hard. Shut her down early before she becomes a problem.
Buy Mercury's Treads to shorten his CC, and watch for his ultimate around objectives.
Nearly unplayable because his E body slam has no real counterplay. Avoid fighting him unless ahead, and do not overchase since he turns fights easily.
His E grants Grit stacks that make him much tankier than his items suggest. Fight him when those stacks have run out.
Fairly simple: knock up his engage with W to stop his damage. Do not try to W him during his ultimate.
His constant shields and CC are very frustrating, and Daisy is not to be underestimated. Mirror his pathing, since counter-ganks shut him down well.
A similar champion to Rek'Sai. You can knock up his E-Q combo with W; otherwise it comes down to skill.
Deny his ganks and plays by exploiting his lack of mobility; his damage is very high. Consider Mercury's Treads against AP-heavy teams, and invade him at Krugs on his first clear.
He can kite you and dodge much of your damage with stealth, but can still be burst down. Mostly a skill matchup.
She can kite you with high damage output. The matchup is about not letting her kite you to death.
Knock up his Q or W attempts, then kill him, but watch for ward-hop jukes and respect his kick. With Goredrinker and Sterak's he outscales you.
Stridebreaker usually shuts her down by letting you catch her easily.
Watch out for his CC, but otherwise he is easy to kill. His saplings give him lots of vision control, so respect them.
An easy matchup since Yi is weak right now and his early ganks are poor, giving you chances to get ahead. Avoid ulting him while his W is active.
Depends heavily on her skill. Knock her up when she pounces onto you.
A good Nocturne can block your W or ultimate with his spell shield. His fear can be dodged with your ultimate. He usually out-tanks you while still dealing big damage.
Comes down to your own knowledge; you need to win skirmishes. Do not start objectives when he is nearby, since his Q plus Smite steals easily.
His ultimate ignores your CC and lets him run you down, but he is only average right now.
Rare in the jungle, but her W blocks your tunnels and she can CC you until you die. Knock up her engage to stop the follow-up.
His updated kit has more CC, including a knock-up on his ultimate, and his high armor makes fights hard.
His W can negate much of your burst. Your W can knock him up mid-leap and cancel his attack damage.
A standard tank matchup; do not let her kite you too much.
Your W reveals him, and he is weak right now, though buffs could change that.
Once knocked up she has few defenses. AP builds still hit hard in dragon form; against AD Shyvana, let her ultimate onto you before using your knock-up.
He shuts down your engages well and his ultimate can set up a one-shot on squishy you. Respect his movement speed.
Her E is a strong counter to your tunnels. She is squishy, so if you reach her you can burst her.
High speed and CC let him kite you. Do not try to one-shot a tanky Udyr; it will not work.
A hard counter: her tanky build and CC shut down your engages. The author considers her worth banning right now.
Good CC and damage but dies easily to a good catch. His passive possession invulnerability can block your ultimate.
His kit counters Rek'Sai, but he lacks the damage to exploit it in his current state.
He has very long engages, protection and burst, and makes it hard for you to peel for your carries.
You can knock him up at any point while he is airborne. Use that and fight him.
Squishy, but her plants clear camps and objectives very fast. Use your ultimate to dodge hers and avoid her biggest burst.
